audit_name: EXP-07 Primary Metric Lock and Mathematical Specification

primary_metric_specification.absent_class_handling: Classes where TP_c + FP_c + FN_c == 0 are omitted from C_eval. If all 11 classes have non-zero union, |C_eval| == 11.
primary_metric_specification.ignore_index_handling: Pixels with label -100 (border padding, Iceberg, Sea Ice, Mineral Oil Spill) are excluded from confusion matrix accumulation.
primary_metric_specification.governance_mandate: GOV-RULE-094. The primary benchmark metric will NEVER be discarded, filtered, or redefined retroactively.
